name: Roadmap item
about: Propose a roadmap item or milestone
title: "[ROADMAP] Short title"
labels: documentation
assignees: ''

**Title**
Short title for the roadmap item.

**Description**
Describe the feature or milestone.

**Priority**
- P0 (critical)
- P1 (high)
- P2 (normal)
- P3 (low)

**Suggested milestones**
List target releases or timeline.

**Rationale**
Why this should be on the roadmap.

**Dependencies**
List any dependencies or related issues.

**Notes**
Any additional notes for maintainers.
